ItemDescription.Value: Voice-command your army (Chinese + English). Say 'cavalry, attack the nearest' / '骑兵打最近的' and it happens: local speech recognition (offline Whisper), fuzzy matching, streaming overlay, and true formation targeting via the game API. Subscribe = everything included; the voice panel auto-starts with the game. 语音指挥你的军队: 本地识别/模糊匹配/直播浮层/真·锁定敌方编队, 订阅即用。
